title: How FX Artists Make #Zombie Puppets Look SO Real (and #Scary!)

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
At the Wonderfest modelmaking show, we meet Star Trek fan and modelmaker Benjamin Spratling, who has handcrafted a series of 1/16 scale dioramas recreating some of the filming sets from Star Trek, The Next Generation, and Voyager! We chat with Benjamin about his build process, his unique approach to lighting, and the use of optical illusions to add depth to these miniature displays. 

Watch more videos from WonderFest here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJtitKU0CAeisqS5CxeSZ5MRXtlTULAqo
